title: Motor claims handler
description:
Spotlightjobs is working with a claims firm, and due to their continued expansion, my client is looking to recruit part-time Motor Claim Handlers/Recoveries Handlers to join their team and play a critical role in securing settlements for their credit hire invoices.

Flexible Part time hours available

Role Overview

As a Recoveries Handler, you will be responsible for recovering credit hire invoices under commercial hire agreements and the GTA (General Terms of Agreement). You will work closely with insurers, negotiating settlements, managing aged debt, and escalating cases through the litigation process when necessary. Given the high-value nature of their clients' vehicles, this role requires a self-starter with a resilient and determined mindset, as well as strong knowledge of credit hire recovery and the GTA.

Basic monthly salary plus monthly bonus up to £750 er month

- Recover high-value credit hire invoices from insurers and at-fault parties in line with commercial hire agreements and the GTA.
- Prepare and submit invoices to insurers, ensuring accuracy and compliance with regulations.
- Negotiate settlements on high-performance vehicle claims, ensuring optimal recovery outcomes.
- Proactively chase aged debt, ensuring timely payments and reducing outstanding balances.
- Escalate cases to litigation where necessary, working with solicitors and legal teams to pursue recovery.
- Liaise with internal teams to ensure smooth processing and resolution of claims.
- Monitor and report on debt recovery progress, identifying trends and opportunities for process improvements.

Required Skills & Experience
- Minimum of 2 years' experience in credit hire recovery within a legal or insurance setting.
- Strong knowledge of the GTA and credit hire litigation processes.
- Proven ability to negotiate settlements on high-value claims and recover outstanding debts efficiently.
- Exceptional resilience, determination, and self-motivation in high-pressure environments.
- Strong organizational skills with excellent attention to detail.
- Effective communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to build strong relationships with insurers and legal teams.
- Proficiency in case management systems and Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, Outlook, etc.).

Benefits:
